words.example: The shop will accessorize the press with a lamp and a tray.
words.exampleZh: 工廠會給這台沖床加裝燈和托盤。
words.notes: 美式拼法 accessorize，英式常拼 accessorise。

words.example: Keep a spare accessory for the guard in the same drawer.
words.exampleZh: 護罩的備用配件放在同一個抽屜。
words.notes: 可數。作「從犯」時，an accessory to 是參與某事的從犯。

words.example: Forcing the pin will aggravate the crack.
words.exampleZh: 硬壓這根銷會讓裂縫更嚴重。
words.notes: be aggravated at 或 with 是因某事生氣。

words.example: Two people can assemble the frame without a hoist.
words.exampleZh: 兩個人不用吊車就能把框架組起來。
words.notes: assemble A into B 是把 A 組裝成 B。

words.example: A short blast of air clears chips out of the jig.
words.exampleZh: 短短一股氣就能把治具裡的碎屑吹掉。
words.notes: at full blast 是全速、全力。a blast of 是一陣。

words.example: A jammed hoist is a delay, not a calamity.
words.exampleZh: 吊車卡住是延誤，不是災難。

words.example: Move the solvent with caution, and keep the cap on.
words.exampleZh: 搬溶劑要小心，蓋子要蓋上。
words.notes: with a caution 是予以警告。caution sb against 是警告某人不要做。

words.example: The gearbox is a key component of this drive.
words.exampleZh: 變速箱是這套傳動的關鍵零件。
words.notes: principal component 是主要成分。

words.example: Do not compound the two resins in an open cup.
words.exampleZh: 不要在敞口杯裡把兩種樹脂混在一起。
words.notes: be compounded of 是由……組成。compound A with B 是把兩者混合。

words.example: The cell needs a comprehensive check before it restarts.
words.exampleZh: 這條線重開之前要做一次全面檢查。
words.notes: be comprehensive of 是把……包括在內。英式英語裡也可指綜合中學。

words.example: This press can compress the offcuts into one bale.
words.exampleZh: 這台壓機能把邊料壓成一捆。
words.notes: compress sth into sth 是把某物壓成另一種形狀。

words.example: Three subassemblies comprise the finished pump.
words.exampleZh: 三個小組件組成這台完成的泵。
words.notes: be comprised of 是由……構成，口語很常見。

words.example: A conscientious fitter checks the torque twice.
words.exampleZh: 盡責的裝配員會把扭力核對兩次。

words.example: If the feeder gets out of control, hit the red stop.
words.exampleZh: 送料若失控，就按紅色停止鈕。
words.notes: be in control of 是控制住某事。

words.example: She had to crawl under the press to reach the loose bolt.
words.exampleZh: 她得爬到沖床底下才搆得到那顆鬆掉的螺栓。
words.notes: creep 是緩慢地移動。作名詞時，crawl 也可指游泳的自由式。

words.example: Set the motor on a rubber cushion, not on the bare bench.
words.exampleZh: 馬達放在橡膠墊上，不要直接放工作臺。
words.notes: 作動詞是緩衝、減輕衝擊。

words.example: You can customize the guard for a left-handed operator.
words.exampleZh: 護罩可以改成適合左撇子作業員。
words.notes: customize sth 是按指定規格改裝或訂製。

words.example: This device stops the press if a hand crosses the beam.
words.exampleZh: 手穿過光束時，這個裝置會讓沖床停下。
words.notes: a device for 是用來做某事的裝置。

words.example: Read the entire drawing before the first hole is drilled.
words.exampleZh: 鑽第一個孔之前，先把整張圖看完。
words.notes: entire 放在名詞前，表示全部都算進去。

words.example: Use the kit in its entirety, not as a pile of loose parts.
words.exampleZh: 這套配件要整組使用，不要拆成散件。
words.notes: in its entirety 是完整地。the entirety of 是……的全部。

words.example: Equip the bench with a lamp before the night shift.
words.exampleZh: 夜班開始前，先給工作臺裝一盞燈。
words.notes: be equipped with 是配備有。過去式是 equipped。

words.example: The calibration is void after the expiration of the certificate.
words.exampleZh: 證書到期後，這次校正就失效。
words.notes: expiration date 是截止日期。另一個意思是呼氣。

words.example: We fabricate the brackets here and buy the motors.
words.exampleZh: 支架我們自己做，馬達則外購。
words.notes: 也可指捏造說法，或搭建一個結構。

words.example: Most of the delay is in fabrication, not in packing.
words.exampleZh: 大部分延誤出在製造，不是包裝。

words.example: The new facility can paint and pack on the same floor.
words.exampleZh: 新廠房可以在同一層噴漆和包裝。
words.notes: production facility 是生產設施。也可指做某事的輕鬆或技巧。

words.example: Tooling time is finite, so the second shift starts tonight.
words.exampleZh: 模具時間有限，所以今晚就開第二班。
words.notes: infinite 是無限的。

words.example: The curtain around the welder is fire-proof.
words.exampleZh: 焊工四周的簾子是耐火的。
words.notes: 也可寫成一個字 fireproof。

words.example: This fitting threads onto the valve by hand.
words.exampleZh: 這個接頭可以用手旋上閥門。
words.notes: it is fitting that 是……是合適的。

words.example: The trial will fizzle if the air supply stays this weak.
words.exampleZh: 供氣一直這麼弱的話，試機就會失敗。
words.notes: fizzle out 是不了了之、最後失敗。

words.example: The schedule has no flexibility once the truck is booked.
words.exampleZh: 卡車訂了之後，時程就沒有彈性了。

words.example: New hires flounder when the drawing and the jig disagree.
words.exampleZh: 圖面和治具不一致時，新進人員會手忙腳亂。
words.notes: flounder through 是掙扎著把某事做完。

words.example: Safety is foremost, and speed comes after the guard is on.
words.exampleZh: 安全第一，護罩裝上之後才談速度。
words.notes: first and foremost 是首先、首要。

words.example: Proper functioning of the stop circuit is checked every morning.
words.exampleZh: 停止迴路是否正常運作，每天早上都要查。
words.notes: functioning 指運作的情形，前面常加 proper 或 normal。

words.example: Replace the fuse before you hunt for a larger fault.
words.exampleZh: 先換保險絲，再去找更大的故障。
words.notes: 也可指導火線。動詞是熔斷，或使金屬熔在一起。

words.example: Scrap is gradually falling after the new jig arrived.
words.exampleZh: 新治具到了之後，廢料逐漸減少。
words.notes: gradually 是一點一點地變，不是突然改變。

words.example: Use a soft hammer so the pin seats without a dent.
words.exampleZh: 用軟鎚把銷打到位，才不會打出凹痕。
words.notes: hammer out 是費力地把辦法敲定。under the hammer 是被拍賣。

words.example: Loose hoses hinder the operator who needs the switch.
words.exampleZh: 鬆掉的軟管會妨礙要用開關的作業員。
words.notes: hinder sb from 是阻止某人做某事。

words.example: The valve will hiss when the seal is nicked.
words.exampleZh: 密封件有缺口時，閥門會嘶嘶響。
words.notes: hiss at 是對某人或某事發出噓聲。

words.example: An improper washer let the bolt back itself out.
words.exampleZh: 墊圈用不對，螺栓自己退了出來。
words.notes: it is improper for sb to do 是某人做某事不恰當。

words.example: The dial indicator shows whether the table is square.
words.exampleZh: 量表可以看出工作臺是否方正。
words.notes: indicator light 是指示燈。

words.example: There are innumerable ways to clamp this part wrong.
words.exampleZh: 這個零件有數不清的錯誤夾法。

words.example: Keep the seal intact until the inspector arrives.
words.exampleZh: 檢驗員來之前，封條要保持完整。
words.notes: leave sth intact 是讓某物保持原樣。

words.example: A blocked intake makes the fan pull hot air from the motor.
words.exampleZh: 進氣口堵住時，風扇會把馬達的熱氣吸進來。

words.example: The guard is an integral part of the press, not an extra.
words.exampleZh: 護罩是沖床不可分的一部分，不是附加品。
words.notes: be integral to 是對……不可或缺。

words.example: Integrate the new sensor with the old stop circuit.
words.exampleZh: 把新感測器接進原來的停止迴路。
words.notes: integrate A with B 是使兩者結合。integrate into 是納入。

words.example: Do not interject until the torque reading is called out.
words.exampleZh: 扭力讀數報完之前不要插話。
words.notes: interject sth into 是把某事插入。

words.example: One interruption at the press can idle the rest of the cell.
words.exampleZh: 沖床停一下，後面的工位也可能跟著閒下來。
words.notes: without interruption 是不間斷地。

words.example: Invert the gearbox before you refill it, so the old oil leaves.
words.exampleZh: 加油前先把變速箱倒過來，舊油才流得掉。

words.example: Grease the joint, or the arm will stick by noon.
words.exampleZh: 接頭要上油，不然到中午手臂就會卡住。
words.notes: joint 也可指共同的，或身體的關節。

words.example: The crew is lacking in practice on this new jig.
words.exampleZh: 這組人對新治具還不夠熟。
words.notes: be lacking in 是缺乏。

words.example: The delay was largely due to a missing pin, not the motor.
words.exampleZh: 延誤主要是少了一根銷，不是馬達的問題。
words.notes: largely 用來說明主要原因，或佔了大部分。

words.example: A laser marks the serial number after the cover is on.
words.exampleZh: 外蓋裝上之後，用雷射打序號。
words.notes: 台灣常用「雷射」。laser printing 是雷射列印。

words.example: Use a longer bar for leverage when the lid is stuck.
words.exampleZh: 蓋子卡住時，用較長的桿子來撬。
words.notes: 可以是用桿子撬，也可以指影響力。

words.example: This line stitches mattress covers, not the springs.
words.exampleZh: 這條線縫的是床墊套，不是彈簧。
words.notes: 複數是 mattresses。

words.example: They will mechanize the lifting, and people will still do the wiring.
words.exampleZh: 搬運會改成機械，配線仍由人做。

words.example: A multitude of small parts has to be kitted before the line starts.
words.exampleZh: 線開動前，大量小零件要先配成套。
words.notes: a multitude of 是大量的人或事物。

words.example: The aisles are numbered because the cart has no navigation aid.
words.exampleZh: 台車沒有導航，所以通道都編了號。
words.notes: satellite navigation 是衛星導航。

words.example: A light-up guard is a novelty, not a safety device.
words.exampleZh: 會發光的護罩只是新鮮玩意，不是安全裝置。
words.notes: 可指新鮮感，也可指新奇的小東西。

words.example: The side panel has to come off before you can reach the belt.
words.exampleZh: 側板拆下來才搆得到皮帶。
words.notes: 也可指一組討論人員，或儀表板。

words.example: Patch the torn guard before the shift starts.
words.exampleZh: 班次開始前，把破掉的護罩補上。
words.notes: patch up 是修補。

words.example: The bit will pierce the sheet in one stroke.
words.exampleZh: 鑽頭一下就能把板子鑽穿。
words.notes: pierce through 是刺穿。

words.example: Do not poke the sensor with a screwdriver.
words.exampleZh: 不要用螺絲起子去戳感測器。
words.notes: poke into 也可指探聽。

words.example: Proficiency on this cell takes about three weeks.
words.exampleZh: 這個工位大約三週才能做熟。
words.notes: proficiency in 是對某項工作很熟。

words.example: This punch makes the hole, and the drill only cleans the edge.
words.exampleZh: 孔是這支沖頭打的，鑽頭只修邊緣。
words.notes: punch in 和 punch out 是上下班打卡。

words.example: If the bracket bows, remake it instead of bending it back.
words.exampleZh: 支架彎了就重做，不要扳回來。
words.notes: 過去式和過去分詞是 remade。

words.example: A rotary table lets one clamp serve four holes.
words.exampleZh: 旋轉工作臺讓一個夾具就能打四個孔。
words.notes: rotary 用來修飾會轉動的裝置。

words.example: Rotate the part a quarter turn, then drill the next hole.
words.exampleZh: 把零件轉四分之一圈，再鑽下一個孔。
words.notes: rotate 是自轉，或人員、任務輪流。revolve 是繞著別的東西轉。

words.example: The fan is noisy at full rotation.
words.exampleZh: 風扇全速轉的時候很吵。
words.notes: in rotation 是輪流。

words.example: The seam split where the two panels meet.
words.exampleZh: 兩片板相接的地方，縫裂開了。
words.notes: be seamed with 是佈滿。

words.example: The cover should sit seamlessly on the base.
words.exampleZh: 外蓋要和底座密合，看不出縫。
words.notes: 意思接近 without any seams。

words.example: The two clamps need simultaneous pressure, or the part twists.
words.exampleZh: 兩個夾具要同時施力，不然零件會扭。
words.notes: be simultaneous with 是與……同時發生。

words.example: Too much slack in the belt lets the pulley slip.
words.exampleZh: 皮帶太鬆，皮帶輪就會打滑。
words.notes: slack off 是鬆懈。形容經濟時是不景氣的。

words.example: The resin will not solidify if the shop stays this cold.
words.exampleZh: 廠房一直這麼冷，樹脂不會凝固。
words.notes: solidly 是堅固地、一致地。

words.example: This stiff bracket keeps the sensor from a side hit.
words.exampleZh: 這片硬支架免得感測器被從側面撞到。
words.notes: be stiff from 是因某動作而僵。口語裡 stiff 也可作副詞，表示徹底地。

words.example: A rib will strengthen the cover without adding much weight.
words.exampleZh: 加一條肋可以加強外蓋，又不會重很多。

words.example: The scratch is only on the surface, so a light polish may save it.
words.exampleZh: 刮痕只在表面，輕拋可能還救得回來。
words.notes: on the surface 是表面上。動詞是浮出水面，或顯現。

words.example: Tap the housing and listen for a loose part inside.
words.exampleZh: 輕敲外殼，聽裡面有沒有鬆掉的零件。
words.notes: give sth a tap 是輕拍一下。

words.example: Keep the belt tense, or it will walk off the pulley.
words.exampleZh: 皮帶要保持張緊，不然會跑出皮帶輪。
words.notes: 比較級 tenser，最高級 tensest。文法上 past tense 是過去時態。

words.example: This unit has its own sensor and does not share the main panel.
words.exampleZh: 這台裝置有自己的感測器，不共用主控制板。
words.notes: a unit of 是一個單位。unit price 是單價。

words.example: Weld the bracket only after the holes are drilled.
words.exampleZh: 孔鑽完再焊支架。

words.example: Check the whole assembly, not only the joint you just made.
words.exampleZh: 整組都要查，不要只查剛做的那個接頭。
